verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for a code-review and workflow platform like Graphite, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents time-based or recurring scheduling. The pricing page lists "Automations" without describing any schedule, and AI reviews run on new pull requests (event-triggered), which is a different behavior from a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
